name: miebaka-joshua-portfolio
description: Build and image-optimization tooling for Miebaka Joshua's static portfolio.

scripts.build: npm run validate:content && npm run build:experiments && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css
scripts.audit:dev-tools: npm audit --audit-level=moderate || echo 'Non-blocking: review dev-tool advisories above; shipped dependencies are gated separately.'
scripts.quality: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:budgets && npm run test:lighthouse && npm run test:lighthouse:mobile && npm run audit:shipped && npm run audit:dev-tools
scripts.test: node --test tests/security.test.mjs && npm run test:content && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:case && npm run test:professional && npm run test:contact-api && npm run test:contact-form && npm run test:listening && npm run test:folders && npm run test:motion && npm run build && npm run test:css && npm run test:intent && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:sizing && npm run test:relative && npm run test:integrity && npm run test:contract && node --test scripts/seo-audit.test.mjs
scripts.test:interaction: PORTFOLIO_INTERACTION_EVIDENCE=1 PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=reports/interaction PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never playwright test tests/e2e --grep @interaction --reporter=line,html --output reports/interaction-results
